system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids

Droids look forward to an Oil Bath after a long period of work. This standard maintenance procedure lubricates the Droid's servos and joints, allowing the Droid to move as if it has just come off the assembly line. A Droid Oil Bath is recommended at least once a week for a Droid working in a harsh environment, and once a month for a Droid working in a temperate climate or on board a ship.

A Droid immersed in an Oil Bath for at least 30 minutes can activate a Second Wind, even if it has already done so that day. The price of a Droid Oil Bath depends on the size of the Droid: Small Droids and smaller, 100 credits; Medium Droids, 1,000 credits; Large Droids, 5,000 credits; Huge Droids and larger, 10,000 credits.
system.source: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
